Short title and Commencement

ACT V OF 2011
ACT V OF 2011
SINDH FISHERIES
(AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2011
An
Act to amend the Sindh Fisheries
Ordinance, 1980.
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV
1st March, 2011]
No.PAS/Legis-B-01/2011,
dated 24-2-2011.---The Sindh Fisheries (Amendment)
Bill, 2011 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh
on 13th January, 2011 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh
on 17th February, 2011 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient to amend the Sindh
Fisheries Ordinance, 1980, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:--
1. Short title
and Commencement. (1) This Act may be called the Sindh
Fisheries (Amendment) Act, 2011.
(2) It shall come
into force at once.

Amendment of Sind Ordinance, No.III of 1980

2. Amendment of
Sind Ordinance, No.III of
1980.---In the Sind Fisheries Ordinance, 1980,
hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, throughout the Ordinance, for
the word "Sind", the word "Sindh" shall be substituted.

Bill, 2011 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh
on 13th January, 2011 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh
on 17th February, 2011 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient to amend the Sindh
Fisheries Ordinance, 1980, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:--
3. Amendment of section
2 of Sind Ordinance No.III of
1980.---In the said Ordinance, in section 2-
(i) after clause (c), the following shall be
added:-
"(c-i)
"Fisherman" means a person who earns his livelihood by catching fish
from All Public Water Bodies and whose primary source of income is the money
which he earns by selling such fish;";
(ii) in clause (g), after the word "canal", the words
"and all other fishing water bodies" shall be added;";
(iii) clause (i) shall be deleted.

Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient to amend the Sindh

It is hereby
enacted as follows:--
4. Amendment of
section 3 of Sind
Ordinance No.III of 1980.---In
the said Ordinance, for section 3, the following shall be substituted:-
"(3) Power
to issue licences for fishing and fish trade.---(1)
Government may, by general or special order, grant licence
for fishing in any public waters on such terms and conditions and on payment of
such fees as may be prescribed.
(2) All the leases
granted prior to the commencement of this section shall stand cancelled.".
